C0921.title: Major Shanghai Insurance Commission Fraud Case Exposes Insurance-Surrender Black Market
C0921.summary: In April 2021, Legal Daily and other media reported a Shanghai insurance commission fraud case involving nearly 10 million yuan. The case exposed an insurance-surrender black-market chain in which illicit agents lured policyholders with promises of full refunds, collected sensitive information such as phone numbers, ID numbers, bank card numbers, and addresses, and then profited through malicious complaints and concentrated policy surrenders that disrupted normal insurance-service processes. The case illustrates combined risks to personal information security, consumer funds, financial order, and insurance operations.
